evidence.section: 3.1 Tensile properties of high-Nb-containing TiAl alloy
evidence.quote: The results of the twin volume fraction showed a gradient density of the mechanical twins along the radial direction from the rim to the center of the samples after torsion and pre-torsional tension.
Compared with the microstructure torsional-deformed at 180° [28], more recrystallization of the γ phase was observed at the twin-twin interactions, a s shown in Fig. 7a.
more recrystallization of the γ phase was observed at the twin-twin interactions
After tensile deformation, stacking faults were widely ob served with twins occurring as shown in Fig. 7b.
Moreover, more dislocations were formed due to the larger deformation in the sample with a torsion of 360°.
